name: Nihongo Master v1.2.0 - Performance Overdrive & Locked 60 FPS Racing Engine
changelog: v1.2.0: Major performance overhaul across all 11 stages in Hiragana & Katakana Road Fighter. Optimized multi-pass ocean water shading with additive texture blending (Stage 2: 12.6ms -> 3.7ms), pre-rendered diagonal striped guardrail patterns (Stage 3: 8.8ms -> 3.1ms), pre-baked terrain surfaces and drop shadows across Stages 5-9, pre-rendered animated stadium grandstands and volumetric lighting beams (Stage 10: 11.1ms -> 3.1ms), and spatial distance culling. All 11 stages now run with total frame time under 13ms (75-108 FPS potential, rock-solid locked 60 FPS on Steam Deck).
